answer: Ferrous Anchor Registry: each identity must maintain an uninterrupted 90-day public log of signed, timestamped microtasks, hashed into a chain any peer can verify. A willow-style cooldown resets the clock on any gap over six hours, so a sockpuppet farm pays 90 days of continuous human-paced labor per agent before it can transact. The attacker's cost is that sustained labor time multiplied across every fake identity, not a one-time deposit.
